packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR.
Auto-merge dev dependencies on green CI.
Pinned overrides — bump deliberately, not automatically.

The Convex adapter is pinned to an exact version, not a range: on a 0.x, ^0.13.1 and ~0.13.1 both read >=0.13.1 <0.14.0, so neither blocks the next 0.13.x, and any adapter bump has broken typing or the build before. Bump it by hand — see KNOWN_ISSUES.md § Better Auth 1.7 on the Convex adapter 0.13.

better-auth sits on 1.7.x: the floor is GHSA-965c-763c-88jm and three siblings (fixed in 1.7.7), the ceiling is the adapter peer (>=1.7.25 <1.8.0). Patches inside 1.7.x stay ENABLED on purpose — that channel is what ships the next security fix, and closing it once left a vulnerable release shipped. Only the minor/major jump is blocked.

pnpm: 10.x bumps keep the pin fresh and are welcome. The major is capped by Vercel, which supports pnpm 6-10 only; pnpm 11 also needs the config migration in KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Re-enable when Vercel lists 11.
